To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dilution ratio of semen in the extender affects the fertility in rams.

dilution of semen with a 10% egg yolk and skim milk diluent, and insemination with a high number of spermato- zoa, resulted in a high conception rate, and a low conception rate was obtained when semen was diluted with a 20% egg yolk diluent and a low number of spermatozooa were inseminated.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of diluents and dilution on the conception rate in the ram.
the effect of different dilution ratios of ram semen on conception rate.
the effect of the ratio between semen and diluent on the fertilizing capacity of ram semen.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a dilution of semen in a diluent with a low concentration of electrolytes (e.g. skim milk or egg yolk) does not reduce the conception rate if a sufficiently large number of spermatozoon is inseminated (e.g. 1.5 x 10' per insemination).
a dilution ratio of 1 : 20 is not detrimental to the fertility of ram semen, but that the conception rate is reduced by the dilution of semen in a ratio of 1:5.
a dilution of ram spermatozoa to 5-10 times the volume of the original semen does not reduce fertility.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the conception rate was reduced when the dilution ratio of ram semen was increased.

the dilution of ram spermatozoa in skim milk to a concentration of 10 10 10 x 10 10 or 10 10 spermatozoa/ml does not cause a significant decrease in the conception rate, if the insemination dose contains 10 10, 10 10. or 10 1 0 10 10 ram spermatozoas.
a dilution ratio 1 : 10 of ram semen in a diluent with a high buffering capacity, e.g. a phosphate buffer, is the maximum dilution ratio which can be tolerated without impairing conception rate.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of diluting the sperm is not just a dilution effect.
dilution of semen with a low concentration of skim milk is a good alternative to dilution with a high concentration of skim milk.
the effect of diluent on the sperm is not as important as the effect of the number of spermatozoids.
